root_cause.text: The sys_futex_requeue() syscall allowed the source and destination futexes to have different flags, leading to inconsistent internal handling and a use-after-free vulnerability.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that an LLM found it possible to create a UaF when sys_futex_requeue() is used with different flags, and the patch adds a check (if (futexes[0].w.flags != futexes[1].w.flags) return -EINVAL;) to mandate identical flags, preventing the mismatch.
